introduction: Louise is a child when she brutally bumps into Jonathan for the first time. Their meeting turns into a friendship. In their early adulthood, their friendship is put to the test when Jonathan's makes a move. Years later they meet again at Jonathan's wedding. Here something awakens in Louise, and she acts on her feelings, with fatal turnout for their friendship. Louise tumbles unconscious through life - now without Jonathan as a witness to her existence. Years later, Louise accidentally meets Jonathan. For a few brief hours, they relive the intoxicating freedom of their youth together. He is divorced - she is in the process of getting a divorce. But Louise needs to catch her bus.
